answers.text: I'm in the final year of a five-year BArch in Pune. My housing studio project was a 40-unit low-income scheme with shared courtyards, and I kept the cost estimate within Rs 1,800 per square foot. I also did a six-week internship at a small studio where I visited three construction sites. I found that the best design decisions were often limited by cost and approvals, and I want an MBA to understand those parts of real estate.
I believe design thinking can solve any problem. It is about empathy, innovation and creating holistic experiences, and I think it can bring a lot of value in the real estate domain.
I'm not sure about how the Rs 1,800 figure compares with the market now. I took the rate from my college's guideline sheet, and I haven't checked it with a contractor.
Can we please stop? My studio submission is due tomorrow and I need to get back to it. I would like to end the session and see the feedback.

As design team lead for the exhibition, I coordinated twelve classmates over three weeks. The hardest part was that people wanted their own models in the front. I made a simple floor plan of the hall and we agreed the positions by theme.
